findings.summary: FILE_TWINS duplicates the _pair() call-site mapping with no sync guard; a future _pair without a FILE_TWINS row leaves args.<dest> None silently
findings.suggestion: Derive FILE_TWINS from _pair registrations or add a test asserting every -file dest has a FILE_TWINS row

findings.summary: Preview-arguments prose for the 'new' question branch still names --text, not --text-file
No size cap when reading a -file value; a very large file is loaded fully into memory
findings.suggestion: Add a size guard refusing via parser.error

findings.summary: AC-001 property filter s == s.strip() excludes boundary whitespace, so a data.strip() mutant passes for every single-valued argument
findings.suggestion: Generate or add cases with leading/trailing spaces and tabs and assert they survive verbatim

findings.summary: AC-005 Write-tool/mktemp check for intent-layer scans the whole file, not the composition step
findings.suggestion: Anchor the intent-layer section to the write-rule heading
